doctrine: Every page is an instrument, not a poster. The hero is the organ doing its job, live. A page cannot choose its own hero - the route registry chooses the hero.
hard_invariant: A page cannot choose its own hero. The route registry chooses the hero. If agents choose heroes, they will make posters. You want instruments.

/.description: The Ground - seismic descent 0m->2000m. Strata IS the nav. The sovereign's autobiography is geology.

/earth.description: The Earth - full-bleed Malay Basin cross-section: layered stratigraphy SVG with slow parallax, live seismic wiggle, depth ruler. Basins map as clickable provinces.

/institution.description: The Proof Engine - live observatory panel: 13 floor-lamps (F1-F13 lit indicators), verdict ticker, Omega-zero gauge at 0.04.

/human.description: The Pulse - one slow breathing line (12 breaths/min), warm amber, MakcikGPT's latest BM headline embedded. WELL vitals as soft numbers, never alarms.

/arif.description: The Stillness - bare. Name, one red F13 pulse, world clock, nothing else moves. The absence of motion IS the hero.

/laws.description: The Tablet - 13 floors as engraved column, quiet serif. Zero color except F13's amber row.

/world/oil.description: The chart IS the hero - full-bleed live Brent chart, ticker tape, verdict line overlaid (RINGGIT WEAK - below 4.50 stress band).
/world/oil.hold_reason: awaiting canon ratification + live data source (wealth organ), not static mock

/world/gas.description: Full-bleed live gas chart, ticker tape, verdict overlay.

/world/gold.description: Full-bleed live gold spot chart, ticker tape, verdict overlay.

/wealth.description: The Capital Judge - one large verdict card: today's NPV/EMV with evidence chain, KLCI + USD/MYR + Brent vitals strip beneath.

/missions.description: The Wheel - torus mission selector with live routing: selecting a mission shows which organ answers.

/mcp.description: The Membrane - live endpoint health: organ endpoints as mono grid with real latency ticking, request log streaming.

/999.description: The Chain - VAULT999 Merkle DAG visualized: recent seals as linked hash blocks, each clickable to its receipt.

/000.description: The Terminal - typewriter genesis (already built). Machine voice, unchanged.

/makcikgpt.description: The Makcik's Table - warm, big BM headline, kopitiam warmth: amber paper texture, latest article as served plate.

/politics.description: The Shadow Board - dark institutional blue, shadow cabinet as org-chart instrument, each seat a dossier link.
